svg.title: A showtime session in Claude Code
svg.desc: A request is typed into Claude Code: make a 20-second launch video for this repo, with a voice-over and upbeat music. Claude states its assumptions, shows a first look, renders on the local machine, and showtime prints its completion card: final.mp4 is ready, 20.0 s, 1920x1080, 17.0 MB, qa PASS, with the output path and the next step.
